**Build's green again.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new shape sends `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The old loader gave `false`.

Both now take either shape. Unset backoff means off, like before.

The 8 warnings are canned text inside `build.js`. They name files that don't exist here.
